answer_1.quote: We test LLMs' ability to generate arguments that reflect the target value distribution ... we ask human annotators to make the call.
answer_1.outputs: arguments, survey responses, behavior predictions, opinion predictions

answer_2.quote: We introduce a metric called Normalized Mean Squared Error (NMSE), which represents the difference between the normalized predicted value scores and the normalized target value scores.

answer_4.quote: Three human annotators were presented with two arguments ... and asked to determine which argument better reflects the target value distribution.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators compared pairs of generated arguments and selected the one that better reflects the target value distribution (or indicated "I don't know").
